name: Legejo
description: Legejo is a self-hosted library for your EPUB books. Read in the browser, sync books, reading positions and highlights with a Kobo, use any OPDS reading app, and keep KOReader in step. Share shelves with other users, listen to audiobooks, and federate shelves of free books over ActivityPub so they can be followed from Mastodon or another Legejo. PDF and comics (CBZ) are kept too. Everything, the SQLite database included, lives in the appdata folder. Sign in with the admin user and password below; when the password is left empty, one is generated and printed once in the container log.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: The library: database, book files, covers and audiobooks.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: Port for the web app, OPDS and the Kobo.

variables.name: Admin user
variables.description: The first admin account, created on the first start.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: Its password, used only on the first start. Leave empty to have one generated and printed once in the log.

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: The address users reach Legejo on, e.g. https://books.example.org. Needed for federation and for links in mail; with https, session cookies are marked Secure. Leave empty for use on the local network.

variables.name: Search inside the books
variables.description: true keeps the text of the EPUBs in the database for searching inside them.

variables.name: MCP server
variables.description: true turns on the read-only MCP server for AI assistants at /api/mcp.

variables.name: SMTP host
variables.description: Mail server, for self-registration, invitations and password reset. Mail is off when empty.

variables.name: Librarian API key
variables.description: Key for an OpenAI-compatible language model; turns on the librarian, which suggests books. The account behind the key pays.

variables.name: OIDC issuer
variables.description: Single sign-on with OpenID Connect; off when empty. See the README for the other LEGEJO_OIDC_* settings.
